sources: compatible declared 32-bit word register or already converted immediate
unsigned 32-bit position (low eight bits used)

operands.aliasing: Incoming source values; unrestricted source/destination overlap and repeated operands.

forms.guard: Unconditional, positive or negative predicate; skipped execution advances PC and emits guard-only read metadata.
forms.meaning: Extract a bit field using only the low eight bits of the unsigned position and length operands. Zero length gives zero. Unsigned padding is zero. Signed padding uses the last extracted bit, or input bit 31 when the field reaches beyond the input. Positions past bit 31 can therefore give all ones for negative signed inputs. The normative syntax supports u32/s32; the source example spelling bfe.b32 is not admitted. Introduced PTX 2.0; requires sm_20.
forms.boundary: Typed Pure32 family selecting bfe.u32, bfe.s32; ISA 94 and numeric SM >= 20. No other widths/options, module parser, declared-register checking, whole-kernel or hardware claim.
